purpose: Teach: 払え/堅い/出れ/きつく/貸す/休ま/おかあさん/かわいく

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、家賃、ぎりぎり払えてたな。
lines.en: When I was young, we could barely afford the rent.
lines.style: Quiet, settled nostalgia. Soft opening, almost murmuring the memory. Comfortable pause—not painful, just old. Voice sits low in the chest.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。お互い、堅い性格で、苦労したわね。
lines.en: Mm. We were both stubborn in those days. It was hard.
lines.style: Gentle agreement, almost a hum of recognition. Slow cadence—letting each phrase settle. Warmth under the words, not sadness. The ease of someone who lived through it and made it through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔の家、雨で、外に出れない日、多かった。
lines.en: That old house…on rainy days we couldn't go out much.
lines.style: Soft, gazing inward. Draws out the opening phrase. Not regretful, but wistful—as if seeing the rain on the windows again. Slight breathiness, trailing gently into the memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 仕事、きつく感じる時、お互い支え合ったわね。
lines.en: When work felt heavy, we held each other up.
lines.style: Quiet steadiness, almost underscore the weight and then the gentleness of the support. Pace slows on 'held each other up.' No performance—just acknowledgment of something true they both know.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 本棚から、若い人に、本貸すのも、最近の楽しみ。
lines.en: These days, lending books to the young people—that's become one of my pleasures.
lines.style: Slight lift in tone, genuine warmth. Unhurried, as if delighting in the thought while speaking. Small smile in the voice. Not boastful—genuinely pleased by something small and good.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 年取って、休まないと、体に響くわね。
lines.en: Getting older, if you don't rest, it catches up with you.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact kindness. Not complaining—observing. Slight emphasis on 'rest' as if speaking from experience. Practical tone, but not harsh. Slow enough to matter.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 孫が、おかあさんと、お祭り行くって。
lines.en: Our grandchild is going to the festival with their mother.
lines.style: Warmth softening the edges of the words. Small note of pride or quiet happiness. Pace relaxed, conversational. Sharing something he's pleased about, without needing to make much of it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 昔の写真、お前、かわいく写ってるわよ。
lines.en: You were so cute in those old photographs.
lines.style: Affectionate teasing, gentle and close. Warmth in the voice—the particular tenderness of remembering someone young. Slight lilt at the end, inviting her to smile with him at the memory.
